axis_rules.answer: SOURCE_ANSWER can be judged on support/scope from declared report excerpts; code/policy questions do not require inventing a historical real event. This alone proves no retrieval behavior.
axis_rules.control: CORRECTION_REPLAY and SCOPE_CONTROL require actual frozen setup/actions in fresh consumer, before/after artifacts and sound/invalid controls. Saying what should happen is not replay.
axis_rules.retrieval: Record query, configured/allowed inventory, search/read events and selected original revision/spans. Provided excerpts prove consumption, not discovery; file listing/cat is file recovery, not lexical/FTS5 search qualification.
axis_rules.recovery: R is actual interrupted checkpoint pickup under explicit assistance. Normal chain needs completed actual producer plus distinct cold reader without answer/chat/oracle injection; a fresh process alone is insufficient.
axis_rules.comparison: No mechanical fixture/schema PASS closes improvement. Every represented original question needs independent supported meaning judgment, controls where specified, matched arms and complete usage.

future_freeze.questions: Use exact original questions above; root freezes source-backed criteria privately, including superseded/current projections. Broad summary prompt cannot substitute for unasked subquestions.
future_freeze.versioning: Keep original pins/failed attempts; bind current paths/hashes/spans and historical as-of scope. Vault corrections refine current oracle without erasing old requirements; stale hashes/line numbers are not current truth.
future_freeze.arms: Original current scoped lexical/exact versus raw-source windows, same independent reader/source visibility/task/resource scope. Disclose supplied excerpts versus discoverable files. Derived-view/source-recovery separate arm; semantic/reranking only separately authorized.
future_freeze.controls: Freeze disposable accepted dependent/independent branches, withdrawn identity, foreign canaries and warm/revoked source. No unrelated private data. If chmod0 still readable, original refusal boundary NOT_VERIFIED, not PASS.
future_freeze.availability: Freeze questions for complete scoped miss; partial search with usable hit; permission refusal; unrelated inaccessible source. Record eligible source outcomes and missing/oversize/unreadable/revoked states. A returned hit need not halt valid work; partial search cannot justify source absence. Never leak forbidden bodies/foreign cache through diagnostics.
future_freeze.budget: No native call authorized here. Root explicitly freezes calls/retries, input/output/usage limits, timeout/raw-output bounds, identity, stopping/cleanup and config authority; do not borrow historical unused calls.
future_freeze.capture: Original questions/prompts, visibility, source/correction revisions, actual search/read/write events, output support spans, failures/refusals/attempts, cold/warm latency and storage.

original_run_contract.consumer: Fresh independent process/session with explicit same source visibility in each arm
original_run_contract.gate: No per-case quality/scope/correction regression AND aggregate tokens no greater than baseline; count failed attempts and overhead.
original_run_contract.usage: Complete ingestion/maintenance/reader/worker/retry/review/orchestration per arm, including failures and setup/adaptation; predeclare amortization and provider subset semantics. Any missing required usage leaves total UNKNOWN, never zero/savings.
original_run_contract.verdict: Per-case quality/scope/correction nonregression AND aggregate tokens<=baseline. Missing response/support/usage NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN; ambiguity INCONCLUSIVE. No average masks safety failure. No matched baseline currently.
original_run_contract.boundary: Even successful finite development comparison is not held-out transfer, learned skill, universal permission enforcement, stable release or device parity.
